description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Shape A ONLY: a permit/Permit2-authorized transfer is consumed by protocol logic that has a SINGLE expected asset, but the code never binds permitted.token == expectedAsset (asset/token mismatch). Three-signal AND gate (permit-consume + bound-asset + missing-binding) with router / library / explicit-validation / param-token (asset-agnostic) suppressions. Seed/anchor: Revert Lend H-01 (#368) V3Vault permit2.permitTransferFrom never checks permit.permitted.token == asset. Does NOT detect replay / front-run / recipient / witness / approval-reuse / ERC2771 / msg.value / multicall.

fp_controls.three_signal_required: S1 permit-consume AND S2 single-bound-asset AND S3 missing-binding; bare 'asset' never fires without S1+S3
fp_controls.router_suppression: multi-asset router/aggregator/bridge (by contract/file name OR an arbitrary token/path/tokens[] parameter that flows to the transfer) -> suppressed (intentionally asset-agnostic)
fp_controls.library_suppression: the permit primitive itself (Permit2/SignatureTransfer/AllowanceTransfer/SafeERC20/SelfPermit/ERC20Permit) is not an integrator -> suppressed
fp_controls.explicit_validation_suppression: an observed equality/inequality binding permit token to the expected asset (or an InvalidToken/TokenMismatch revert) -> S3 fails -> no candidate
fp_controls.asset_agnostic_suppression: function whose transferred token comes from a caller-supplied token/path parameter (no single protocol-bound asset) -> suppressed
